name: [🚗] Create A Disaster💥
desc:
💥 Blow everything up, earn cash, unlock more disasters!
👍 Like the game to unlock the next update

Update 2:
🚗 AI Cars driven by your friends! (6 different vehicles!)
🎁 Playtime Rewards
💰 More cash per disaster

☄️ Drop meteors, tornadoes, nukes, black holes and more
🐙 Summon the Kraken, a giant Kaiju or a crashing space station, each with its own unique cutscene
🔥 Chain different disasters for combo bonuses
🎁 Free rewards every day, daily challenges and global leaderboards

🎮 Available on Console, Phone, Tablet, PC

AI cars driven by friends' avatars
update_signals: like goal to unlock next update
